title: Annual PhD Studentships Competition
about: Ulster University's Annual PhD Studentships Competition for September 2027 entry opened on 9 October 2026. Applications, including all supporting documents, are due by 4pm on 8 January 2027; interviews are expected in early to mid-February 2027.
requirements: First or Upper Second Class Honours degree, held or expected (official pages differ on the year)
card_alt: Card for the Annual PhD Studentships Competition at Ulster University, United Kingdom, deadline 8 Jan 2027. The photo shows Big Ben and Westminster Bridge in London, not an Ulster University campus.
